lines.en: label day120:
scene street_noon
I find myself walking home after yet another uneventful day at[school].
lines.zh: 又是一个在[school]平淡无奇的日子，我正走在回家的路上。

lines.en: And I say ‘uneventful’ in the loosest possible sense because Yumi actually showed up today, and that’s always something to celebrate.
lines.zh: 而我说「平淡无奇」，用的是最宽松的说法，因为 Yumi 今天居然来上课了，这本身就值得庆祝。

lines.en: Well, it’s something to celebrate when I’m not forcing her to stop insulting the other girls in order to make up for her...apparent inferiority complex?
lines.zh: 嗯，值得庆祝——前提是我不用逼她停止辱骂其他女生，来弥补她那……明显的自卑情结？

lines.en: Now that I think of it, I don’t really understand why Yumi is so mean to everyone to begin with.
lines.zh: 这么一想，我其实不太明白 Yumi 一开始为什么对谁都那么刻薄。

lines.en: It has to be an inferiority complex, right? That’s normally how the bully trope goes.
lines.zh: 肯定是自卑情结吧？霸凌角色不都是这么设定的吗。

lines.en: And God forbid these girls start subverting their character tropes. That would really throw me off.
lines.zh: 而且老天保佑，这些女孩可千万别开始颠覆自己的角色套路。那真会让我措手不及。

lines.en: : Hey! Tall guy! Over here!
lines.zh: : 嘿！高个子！这边！

lines.en: : Tall guy?
lines.zh: : 高个子？

lines.en: scene black
scene girlsagain1
: Yo!
: Why are you suddenly calling me “tall guy?”
lines.zh: : 你怎么突然叫我「高个子」了？

lines.en: scene girlsagain2
: Huh? Cause you’re tall and you’re a guy. I thought it was pretty obvious.
lines.zh: : 哈？因为你个子高，又是个男的啊。我觉得挺明显的吧。

lines.en: : Well...I mean, yes. But you’ve never called me that before. It makes it sound like we don’t know each other.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我是说，没错。可你以前从没这么叫过我。听起来像是我们不认识似的。

lines.en: : Who cares? The only other person around is Sana and I’m pretty sure she knows that we’re cool.
lines.zh: : 有什么关系？周围就只有 Sana 一个人，我敢肯定她知道我们关系好。

lines.en: Once Rin points that out, I realize that the streets are eerily empty today. I wonder if it’s because of the heat?
lines.zh: 被 Rin 这么一提醒，我才意识到今天街上空得有点诡异。是不是因为太热了？

lines.en: No, that can’t be it. Both of them are wearing long sleeves.
lines.zh: 不，不对。她俩都穿着长袖呢。

lines.en: Where the hell is everyone?
lines.zh: 大家都跑哪儿去了？

lines.en: : Well, either way, go back to calling me Sensei. I don’t want to be “tall guy” anymore.
lines.zh: : 总之，还是叫我 Sensei 吧。我不想再当「高个子」了。

lines.en: if cafe25 == True:
: It’s bad enough that Kaori is already calling me Hamburger Man. Another nickname would be too much to keep track of.
lines.zh: : 光是 Kaori 叫我汉堡人就已经够糟的了。再来一个绰号我可记不过来。

lines.en: scene girlsagain3
: Um...isn’t...there already a real Hamburger Man?
lines.zh: : 那个……不是已经有一个真正的汉堡人了吗？

lines.en: : A...real Hamburger Man?...
lines.zh: : 一个……真正的汉堡人？……

lines.en: : Are you talking about the one from that fast food chain? The clown dude?
lines.zh: : 你是说那家快餐连锁店的那个？小丑大叔？

lines.en: scene girlsagain4
: Yeah. Isn’t he called...the Hamburger Man?
lines.zh: : 嗯。他不就叫……汉堡人吗？

lines.en: : Uh...no.
lines.zh: : 呃……不是。

lines.en: : He’s got like, an actual name. I just don’t think we’re allowed to say it on-screen because of copyright stuff.
lines.zh: : 他是有正经名字的。我只是觉得因为版权什么的，我们在画面里不能说出口。

lines.en: scene girlsagain5
: Oh...well, um...
lines.zh: : 哦……那个，嗯……

lines.en: : I think...I’m going to keep calling him the Hamburger Man anyway...
lines.zh: : 我想……我还是继续叫他汉堡人吧……

lines.en: : Two hamburger people is too many...I think Sensei should change.
lines.zh: : 两个汉堡人太多了……我觉得 Sensei 该换一个。

lines.en: I am tired of being a hamburger-person. Take me out of this isekai right now.
lines.zh: 我受够了当什么汉堡人。现在就把我送出这个异世界吧。

lines.en: else:
: Are you sure? You can be Tall Guy and Sana can be Short Girl. You’ll be like a superhero duo.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？你可以当高个子，Sana 当矮个子女孩。你们就像超级英雄二人组一样。

lines.en: scene girlsagain4
: Um...what would that make you then, Rin?...
lines.zh: : 那个……那 Rin 你算什么？……

lines.en: : Uhh, I don’t know?...Average-height Lass?
lines.zh: : 呃，我不知道？……平均身高少女？

lines.en: : That’s...not a very good superhero name...
lines.zh: : 那……不太像个超级英雄的名字……

lines.en: : So, nicknames aside, I’m glad to see you two are getting along.
lines.zh: : 好了，先不说绰号，我很高兴看到你们俩处得这么好。

lines.en: scene girlsagain6
: Dude, same! Sana and I have like, a zillion things in common. Who would have ever thought?
lines.zh: : 真的，我也是！我跟 Sana 有超级多共同点。谁能想到呢？

lines.en: : Wow. How close have the two of you gotten over the last few weeks?
lines.zh: : 哇。这几周你们俩已经这么亲近了？

lines.en: : Rin let me touch her skulls.
lines.zh: : Rin 让我摸她的骷髅头。

lines.en: : I did! No one’s ever asked to do that before.
lines.zh: : 对啊！以前从没有人提出过这种要求。

lines.en: : Even Futaba is like “Umm...can you turn those away when I’m trying to sleep?”
lines.zh: : 连 Futaba 都是「呃……我睡觉的时候你能不能把它们转过去？」

lines.en: : I basically have to give her a friggin’ pep talk every night. But Sana here just walked up to them and started doing the Hamlet thing.
lines.zh: : 我基本上每天晚上都得给她做一通该死的思想工作。可 Sana 直接就走到它们跟前，开始演哈姆雷特那一套。

lines.en: : She...spontaneously recited a monologue to a skull?
lines.zh: : 她……对着一个骷髅头即兴念了一段独白？

lines.en: scene girlsagain7
: Um...that part...didn’t happen.
lines.zh: : 那个……那部分……没发生。

lines.en: : I kind of just...held one for a little while.
lines.zh: : 我只是有点……拿了一个，拿了一会儿。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Totally misremembered that scene in my head. Whoops.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我在脑子里把那个场景完全记错了。哎呀。

lines.en: : But yeah, Sana’s basically like a little sister to me already. Which is cool cause I’m kind of like Futaba’s little sister.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的，Sana 对我来说已经像妹妹一样了。这挺酷的，因为我有点像 Futaba 的妹妹。

lines.en: : So the three of us are gonna form a sisterhood and start sharing pants or however that one story goes.
lines.zh: : 所以我们三个要结成一个姐妹会，开始共享裤子，或者那个故事是这么讲的吧。

lines.en: I glance at Sana, who seems content but still struggling to keep up with Rin’s, uhh, pace.
lines.zh: 我瞥了一眼 Sana，她看起来很满足，但依旧在努力跟上 Rin 的，呃，节奏。

lines.en: Having known the two of them for some time now, I can see how they’d get along so well, but I can also see how it might be difficult at times.
lines.zh: 认识她们俩有一段时间了，我能看出她们为什么这么合得来，但也看得出有时候会有点吃力。

lines.en: Rin is adept when it comes to communicating with people, but lacks a filter.
lines.zh: Rin 擅长与人交流，但少了个过滤器。

lines.en: And, of course, Sana is the complete opposite.
lines.zh: 而 Sana 当然恰恰相反。

lines.en: But either way, I’m glad to see the two of them spending time together like this.
lines.zh: 不过不管怎样，我很高兴看到她们俩这样待在一起。

lines.en: scene girlsagain8
: Um...I don’t know much about...sharing pants...but I am really happy to have another friend now.
lines.zh: : 那个……我不太懂……共享裤子……不过能再多一个朋友，我真的很开心。

lines.en: : Ayane is...still a little too much for me sometimes...
lines.zh: : Ayane 有时候……对我来说还是有点太过了……

lines.en: scene girlsagain9
: Oooooh, I totally forgot you two were even roommates! I don’t really talk to Ayane that much.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，我完全忘了你俩居然是室友！我不太跟 Ayane 说话。

lines.en: : What’s she like? That sword she brought in the other day was really cool. Do you think she’d let me hold it?
lines.zh: : 她人怎么样？她那天带来的那把剑超酷的。你觉得她会让我拿一下吗？

lines.en: : Um...I don’t really know if she’d let you hold it...but she’s really nice.
lines.zh: : 那个……我不太确定她会不会让你拿……不过她人真的很好。

lines.en: : She was willing to get to know me when nobody else was so...I’m really thankful for her.
lines.zh: : 在没人愿意的时候，她愿意来了解我，所以……我真的很感激她。

lines.en: scene girlsagain10
: Dude, everyone is willing to get to know you. You’ve just gotta put in some of the work.
lines.zh: : 拜托，谁都愿意来了解你的。你自己也得付出点努力啊。

lines.en: : People are like, totally weird and annoying and stuff, but no one is gonna see you and be like “Nahh I’m good.”
lines.zh: : 人是挺奇怪、挺烦的之类的，但不会有人看到你就说「算了，我不用了」。

lines.en: : You’ve just gotta do the thing and then stuff will happen.
lines.zh: : 你只要去做那件事，然后事情自然就会发生。

lines.en: scene girlsagain11
: Umm...can you...
lines.zh: : 那个……你能不能……

lines.en: : You need me to translate for you?
lines.zh: : 需要我帮你翻译一下吗？

lines.en: : Yes please...
lines.zh: : 好的，麻烦了……

lines.en: scene girlsagain12
: Wait...did I say something weird? What part about that was confusing?
lines.zh: : 等等……我说了什么奇怪的话吗？哪部分让你听不懂？

lines.en: : I think Rin is trying to say that everyone would be open to being your friend because of how cute you are.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Rin 是想说，因为你很可爱，所以谁都会愿意跟你做朋友。

lines.en: scene girlsagain13
: Yeah! That! That’s much easier to understand than how I put it!
lines.zh: : 对！就是这个！比我的说法好懂多了！

lines.en: : Wh-what?!
lines.zh: : 什、什么？！

lines.en: scene girlsagain14
: Sana, you probably don’t realize this since you’re like, super shy and awkward and stuff, but you’re low-key one of the cutest girls in the entire world.
lines.zh: : Sana，你可能自己没意识到，因为你又害羞又拘谨什么的，但你绝对是全世界最可爱的女孩之一。

lines.en: : Kind of like a cross between a lost kitten and an excited puppy. Oh- and like, four baby seals thrown into the mix.
lines.zh: : 有点像迷路的小猫和兴奋的小狗的合体。哦——再掺进去四只小海豹。

lines.en: scene girlsagain15
: That’s too many things! I’m just a girl!
lines.zh: : 这也太多了吧！我就是个女孩子而已！

lines.en: : Yeah but girls are the best! There’s a reason I’m so into-
lines.zh: : 是啊，但女孩子最棒了！我之所以那么喜欢——

lines.en: scene girlsagain16
: Ah-!
Uh-oh.
lines.zh: 哎呀，糟了。

lines.en: scene girlsagain17
: Huh?
: Into what?
lines.zh: : 喜欢什么？

lines.en: : Umm...uhh...
scene girlsagain18
: Makeup! I’m really into makeup! Because...it looks better on girls than it looks on boys!
lines.zh: : 化妆！我特别喜欢化妆！因为……化妆品涂在女生脸上比涂在男生脸上好看！

lines.en: : Oh...umm...I see...
lines.zh: : 哦……那个……这样啊……

lines.en: scene girlsagain19
: Pah...
lines.zh: : 哈啊……

lines.en: Rin suddenly deflates as she narrowly avoids revealing to her new friend that she’s [[probably] sexually attracted to her.
lines.zh: Rin 突然泄了气，险些没让她的好朋友发现她[[大概]对她有性方面的吸引。

lines.en: I can only imagine how finding out something like that would impact Sana, who I’m pretty sure is at least six-hundred years away from becoming curious about romance.
lines.zh: 我只能想象，如果 Sana 知道了这种事会受多大的冲击——我敢肯定她离对恋爱产生好奇至少还有六百年。

lines.en: : Sensei...I, um...
lines.zh: : Sensei……我，那个……

lines.en: : I want to...thank you again for...all of your help.
lines.zh: : 我想……再次感谢你……为我做的一切。

lines.en: : Without you...I wouldn’t be able to-
lines.zh: : 如果没有你……我不可能——

lines.en: : Don’t thank me yet, Sana. Your character arc has barely even started.
lines.zh: : 先别谢我，Sana。你的角色成长弧才刚刚开始呢。

lines.en: scene girlsagain20
: My...what?
lines.zh: : 我的……什么？

lines.en: : I told you in class the other day. We can’t call it quits on your progression until you’re friends with everyone.
lines.zh: : 前几天上课时我跟你说过了。在你和所有人都成为朋友之前，我们不能说你的成长已经结束。

lines.en: : Don’t make it sound like doubling your previous count of just one friend is enough to satisfy me.
lines.zh: : 别搞得好像把你之前仅仅一个朋友的数量翻个倍，就够让我满意了似的。

lines.en: : But two is already hard! Look at Rin! She deflated and I don’t even understand why!
lines.zh: : 可两个就已经很难了！你看 Rin！她泄气了，我甚至不知道为什么！

lines.en: : That...is something you’ll have to find out later. I’m not really able to disclose other peoples’ secrets to you.
lines.zh: : 那个……你得以后自己去发现。我不能把别人的秘密透露给你。

lines.en: scene girlsagain21
: Secrets?! I don’t have any secrets! You take that back, Tall Guy!
lines.zh: : 秘密？！我才没有什么秘密！你给我收回那句话，高个子！

lines.en: : How am I back to that nickname already? I thought we were done with this.
lines.zh: : 怎么又变回那个绰号了？我以为这事儿已经过去了。

lines.en: : We were until you decided to hint at my...thoughts to Sana! She is too pure for such things!
lines.zh: : 本来是过去了，直到你决定把我的……心思暗示给 Sana！她太纯洁了，不该听这种事！

lines.en: scene girlsagain22
: Um...are you...keeping a secret from me?
lines.zh: : 那个……你……在瞒着我什么吗？

lines.en: : I don’t have the most...experience...when it comes to friends...but you don’t have to hide anything...
lines.zh: : 在交朋友这件事上，我确实没什么……经验……但你什么都不用瞒着我……

lines.en: : I’ll accept you no matter what...
lines.zh: : 不管怎样我都会接受你的……

lines.en: scene girlsagain23
: Look what you did.
lines.zh: : 看看你干的好事。

lines.en: : How is this my fault?
lines.zh: : 这怎么成我的错了？

lines.en: : I don’t know. But it is.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。但就是。

lines.en: : That seems a little unfair, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 这好像有点不公平吧，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : I think I’m going to chop your arms off the next time we’re alone together.
lines.zh: : 我想下次我们单独在一起的时候，把你的胳膊砍下来。

lines.en: : Um...excuse me...
lines.zh: : 那个……不好意思……

lines.en: : I don’t really...understand what’s going on right now...
lines.zh: : 我不太……明白现在发生了什么……

lines.en: : But I’d like it if...you two would stop fighting...
lines.zh: : 不过我希望……你们俩别吵了……

lines.en: scene girlsagain22
: Ah- We’re not fighting! We’re just doing that thing where we, uhh, play-fight because we’re so close!
lines.zh: : 啊——我们没在吵架！我们只是在做那种……呃，打打闹闹的事，因为我们关系太好了！

lines.en: : You are?...
: Yeah!
scene girlsagain24
: Um...I’m sorry if this is personal but...would you mind explaining...how close you are?
lines.zh: : 那个……如果这问题太私人的话就抱歉了……你能不能解释一下……你们有多亲近？

lines.en: : Just so I can...better understand the relationship...between you two...
lines.zh: : 这样我才能……更好地理解你们俩之间……的关系……

lines.en: scene girlsagain25
Rin stares again, expecting me to be the one to answer this question.
lines.zh: Rin 又盯着我，指望由我来回答这个问题。

lines.en: Thankfully, I have the perfect response for a time like this.
lines.zh: 所幸，这种时候我正好有一个完美的回答。

lines.en: : Ahem...
lines.zh: : 咳咳……

lines.en: if cafe25 == True:
: We are homies.
lines.zh: : 我们是 homies。

lines.en: else:
: We're bros.
lines.zh: : 我们是 bros。

lines.en: scene girlsagain26
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : You’re...what?
lines.zh: : 你们……是什么？

lines.en: : And on that note, I will take my leave.
lines.zh: : 那么，就此告辞。

lines.en: : Good day, huma-
lines.zh: : 祝你愉快，人——

lines.en: : Uhh...girls. Good day, girls.
lines.zh: : 呃……女孩们。祝你们愉快，女孩们。

lines.en: I slowly back away from the table and begin to make my way toward the bus stop to head home.
lines.zh: 我慢慢从桌边退开，开始朝公交车站走去，准备回家。

lines.en: scene girlsagain27

lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: if cafe25 == True:
: What’s a “homie?”
lines.zh: : 「homie」是什么？

lines.en: else:
: Why did he call you a...bro?
lines.zh: : 他为什么叫你……bro？

lines.en: scene black
$ rin_love += 1
$ sana_love += 1
$ day120 = True
Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!
lines.zh: Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]！

lines.en: Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!
lines.zh: Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]！

lines.en: jump endofweekday
